items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And so he taught me to sing and later I studied a little bit of dancing.

ctx.x: Well, it's very difficult, really, because I've lived a long time, I can't remember the earliest things, but I still recollect the fact that my father and mother were very interested in my having some sort of musical career, preferably in the theatre.

And with this in mind, my father, who I guess was a frustrated singer, to some degree, decided I would be the completion of his ambitions. And so he taught me to sing and later I studied a little bit of dancing. But his whole intent was to make me a performer of one kind of another, and I guess he must have been able to do that, because I did my first tour when I was nine years old. And with some of the money I earned from that tour, which was a summertime tour, I was able to buy a saxophone and then later, a…
What were you doing on that tour?
